cases.rationale: A visibly stuffed brown teddy bear has plush fabric, sewn features and a decorative ribbon, so teddy bear is yes and actual bear is no. The brass-colored open round object at the bottom is partly cropped; it could be a bowl or a flared instrument bell, leaving bowl unclear. Rose stems and leaves have no visible growing pot or vase. The ribbon is not an identifiable necktie. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no other category object is identifiable.

An actual tabby cat sits in an upholstered individual armchair, with a black button-covered remote resting against its belly. The seat has the enclosing arms of a single chair rather than an identifiable sofa or bed. The remote has a recognizable control-button layout rather than phone or keyboard identity. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no other category object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

A tall handleless drinking glass of iced beverage is cup yes, and the cropped red narrow-neck container at upper right is a bottle. A spoon bowl and handle and a fork with tines lie beside the glass on its saucer. The foreground chocolate ring pastry is an identifiable donut. The plates and drink establish an eating table; the plates are not bowls. A dark upright form behind the table could be a chair back but is insufficiently exposed to identify, so chair is unclear. No blade supports knife, and no cake is identifiable. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

A small airborne watersports participant is visible above the surf near the center, supporting person. The tiny colored apparatus above and below the rider cannot be resolved well enough to establish an actual kite body/string assembly or a surfboard rather than another watersports board, so kite and surfboard remain unclear. Neither an airplane nor bird is identifiable. Waves, hillside vegetation and sky supply no other category objects. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

A large two-door refrigerator dominates the crop, and a built-in conventional oven with its door and control panel is visible at left. The white appliance on the refrigerator is a toaster, not an identifiable microwave. At right the fruit pile includes curved bananas and a round orange; a partly cropped reddish fruit could be an apple but lacks enough detail, so apple is unclear. The remaining yellow fruit is not automatically orange. Cabinets and countertop are not a dining table, and the pots in back contain no identifiable plants. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

Several actual people stand around an open laptop with an integrated screen and visible keyboard. The depicted person on that screen is excluded as a separate actual person, and the integrated screen is not a standalone TV. Small upright metallic drinking tumblers stand behind the laptop. Background greenery lacks a clearly resolved pot, leaving potted plant unclear. A partly occluded rectangular paper/cover stack on the foreground work surface could be a bound book, leaving book unclear. The counter/work display surface is not an identifiable dining table. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

An actual tennis player in a red dress holds an identifiable strung tennis racket by its handle on a lined court. The cap and clothing do not establish any bag or tie. The court, painted lines and small tennis ball are outside the other supplied categories. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no other category object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

A large handled mug is a cup. A whole orange with peel texture sits at lower left, and the compartmented food tray contains identifiable broccoli florets and carrot sticks. The small red oval foods are tomatoes rather than apples or oranges. The rough round baked-looking item inside the mug could be muffin/cake-like food or another preparation; cake identity is unresolved, so cake is unclear. The plastic food packaging is a compartmented tray rather than identifiable bowls, and the speckled surface is a countertop rather than an eating table. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

The crop shows the rear of an actual elephant with a human rider, a large road tanker truck, and a distant person beside/riding a pedal bicycle at the right roadside. The tanker body and road wheels establish truck rather than bus or train. Trees and roadside ground have no pot evidence, and no other listed animal is visible. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The large shiny brown-and-white cow-shaped confection/sculpture is an artificial figure, not an actual cattle animal. Its smooth chocolate-like body does not identify cake. Wrapped sweets, ribbons and shop displays are present, with no identifiable plush bear. A small upright pale package/container in the upper background could be a bottle, but its neck and opening cannot be resolved sufficiently to distinguish it from packaging, so bottle is unclear. The retail counter is not an identifiable dining table. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop.

A man uses a knife to cut bread at an eating table. Open bread portions with visible filling on the plate are sandwiches; the plain loaves alone are not sandwiches or donuts. A button-covered remote lies in the foreground. Behind him are a conventional cooking range with oven, an identifiable sink basin at right, and a yellow narrow-neck squeeze bottle by the wall. Plates and food tubs are not bowls or drinking cups. Papers on the table are not a bound book. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual pedestrians are visible, including a foreground traveler pulling two structured travel suitcases by their extended handles. The shiny soft bag carried at her shoulder is a handbag/shoulder bag rather than a backpack. A small dark form with a reddish patch behind her at upper left could be part of a parked car, but storefront reflections and occlusion prevent a determinate vehicle identification, so car is unclear. The distant wheeled shapes do not identify a pedal bicycle. All 75 frozen definitions were considered against the whole crop; no other category object is identifiable.
